rules.name: Docker & Infrastructure
rules.description: Changes to container definitions, orchestrators, and infrastructure code
checklist: Verify base image version pinning and security scanning
Check build context exclusions (.dockerignore) to prevent leaking secrets
Ensure containers run as non-root users with least-privilege capabilities
Verify resource limits (CPU/memory) and healthcheck configurations

rules.name: CI/CD & Workflows
rules.description: Changes to pipeline definitions, build scripts, and automation
checklist: Confirm all third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to full 40-character commit SHAs
Verify least-privilege permissions block (e.g., permissions: {}) at workflow root
Ensure runner secrets are not echoed or exposed in logs
Verify fork safety (pull_request vs pull_request_target)

rules.name: Authentication & Security
rules.description: Changes affecting authentication, authorization, cryptography, and access control
checklist: Verify session expiration and secure cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite)
Check password hashing algorithms and salt parameters
Ensure authorization checks are performed on every protected API endpoint
Check that sensitive credentials and tokens are never logged or stored in plain text

rules.name: Database & Migrations
rules.description: Changes to database schema, migrations, ORM entities, and raw queries
checklist: Verify backward compatibility for zero-downtime rolling deployments
Ensure migration includes safe rollback or reversible operations
Check column additions on large tables for blocking locks and timeout settings
Verify parameterization of all dynamic SQL queries to prevent SQL injection

rules.name: Core Dependencies
rules.description: Modifications to package manifests and lockfiles
checklist: Confirm new dependencies have an active maintenance status and reputable license
Check vulnerability advisories (npm audit, safety, govulncheck)
Ensure lockfile is committed and matches manifest changes exactly
Evaluate bundle size impact for client-facing libraries

rules.name: Test Suites
rules.description: Changes to unit, integration, or end-to-end test suites
checklist: Verify tests assert meaningful behaviors rather than mocking the tested logic
Check for test flakiness (deterministic waits, no race conditions)
Ensure new code paths have corresponding positive, negative, and edge-case tests
